capabilities: Pins web links and any file type to a left ribbon bar
Groups items into unlimited nested folders with cascading menus
Adds, reorders and manages bookmarks via drag and drop or Settings
Opens items in tabs, split panes or windows with click modifiers
Tints Lucide, brand or custom SVG icons with the current theme
extras: No telemetry; the only network requests are the user-initiated icon search and site logo lookup. Interface language: automatic, English or Spanish. Requires Obsidian 1.13.0 or later.
problem: Obsidian offers no one-click bar in the left ribbon for frequently used links, files and folders with grouping, separators and drag-and-drop.

relations.evidence: and Open Tab Settings when it is installed.

summary: Ribbon bookmark bar in the left sidebar for web links, any file type, nested folders and separators, with drag-and-drop and theme-tinted icons.
